report:
Fresh review performed from the current start output, not the previous verdict. The current inventory contains two ordinary implementation entries, observe.rs and source.rs, and eight ordinary tests; no TODO/N/A entries or deferral prerequisites are present. Additional captured dependencies are the compile runner, marker parser, FrozenType conversion/completeness/rendering, and expression span construction.

The claim requires exact file/start-line selection, inclusion of multiline expressions and siblings, exclusion of earlier/later starts and containing blocks, one row per source expression, readable filename/kind/source/completed-type output without coordinates, one ordered snapshot across markers, file/line/postorder sorting, marker deduplication without text deduplication, source nesting and generated-node control, coercion wrapper ordering/types, explicit failure for empty or unreliable correspondence, and expression-only selection. The examples additionally require the nested tuple order, the inner-call-only selection, and line-independent snapshot coordinates.

Implementation: source::walk is exhaustive over ExprCstKind and visits children before pushing a source row; statement traversal visits initializer expressions but not binding declarations or function declarations. observe::walk_symbol obtains checked bodies, walks the typed expression tree, enumerates source expressions, and chooses a unique same-span candidate, preferring the source kind. Generated semantic rows therefore cannot independently produce observations. A missing/ambiguous match produces an invalid row, and collect rejects invalid or incomplete rows explicitly before formatting. The no-expression branch rejects an empty target selection. walk_expr resolves spans to the logical file and counts newlines before the start. collect requires equal file and start line; it does not test intersection. Hence multiline starts remain selected and containing blocks starting earlier remain excluded.

Ordering: BTreeSet<(file,line)> sorts targets and deduplicates repeated markers. Source traversal retains sibling order and nesting. Stable sorting by file, end, and reverse start produces child-before-parent order, retaining traversal order for equal keys. Individual rows are never deduplicated by rendered text. Semantic coercions are traversed after their children, excluded from the base-candidate choice, and appended after their matching source expression; same-span wrapper chains preserve their typed postorder. Other generated nodes, such as implicit dereferences, are not appended. The parsed-source span constructor uses syntax-node byte ranges and allocates one node per expression; valid enclosing syntax has its own delimiters/operators, while equal-span generated wrappers are handled separately. There is no demonstrated reachable same-kind/equal-span source ambiguity requiring a synthetic injection test. Missing-child/unresolved representations are rejected by the correspondence guards, whose handling was source-inspected rather than claimed as an executed ambiguous-CST case.

Output: collect formats only logical filename, kind, compact source, and FrozenType. compact uses Rust syntax leaves, removes annotation comments, normalizes inter-token whitespace, and escapes multiline/literal text. FrozenType reads completed typed IR and recursively checks missing components; expected strings cannot change semantic types because CompileTest prepares first and compares afterward. Omitting coordinates explains why moving expressions without changing order does not itself change the snapshot.

Complete test accounting: call_argument_types contains the documented multiline call scenario and exactly asserts inner path/literal/call with completed types, excluding the outer call/body and later literal. tuples_and_multiline_descriptions asserts sibling-before-parent order, repeated marker collapse, the selected multiline tuple but not its later-line literals, and compact source text. files_lines_and_identical_siblings_keep_source_order deliberately reverses fixture/module input order and asserts sorted logical paths, ordered marked lines, nested tuple postorder, duplicate-marker collapse, and retention of two identical literal entries. implicit_dereferences_do_not_duplicate_source_observations asserts exactly the source path and field despite generated dereference elaboration. coercion_wrapper_follows_its_source_expression asserts literal, return of never type, then the same-source coercion with resulting u16 type. unicode_and_indentation_do_not_change_line_type_selection asserts literal followed by a same-line body block, without function declaration or coordinates. function_declaration_is_not_an_expression requires the specific no-expression failure on a declaration line whose body starts later. expectations_and_source_selections_must_agree asserts expectation/marker consistency and the empty selection on a closing brace rather than selecting an earlier-starting body. These are explicit scenario/expected-output assertions, not opaque verification helpers. The correspondence-error guards and general chain ordering were additionally inspected structurally; the tests exercise real source selection failures and the supported equal-span coercion case, not synthetic internal-state injection.

Assessment: current implementation and tests adequately establish the complete claim and its qualifications. No production or test edits are requested. This refresh executed review start/read/record tooling only; no behavior tests or build were rerun by this reviewer. The coordinator centrally runs the relevant suites. Prior test runs are not asserted as current execution evidence.
